targets.descriptor: Oversized single-breasted blazer with a long, wide notched lapel that rolls to a low two-button stance sitting around the natural waist; the body hangs straight and loose with substantial drop-shoulder construction so the shoulder line falls well past the wearer's own shoulders and the armhole sits low on the upper arm. Long sleeves nearly reach the knuckles, pushed slightly so the hand enters the lower welt pocket. Flap pockets sit at the lower front hips and a welt pocket sits on the left chest; the overall drape is soft and tailored rather than crisply structured, the cloth falling in gentle folds while holding the jacket's columnar line.
